_about: Evaluation pool that mirrors the opponents met at the target rating band, per lineage.
Weights come from scripts/ladder_mix.py (band 2450-2850, episodes since 2026-09-19,
Unnamed lineages (~24% of labelled seats, no local agent file) are left out.
herd-safe is too new for the dataset (it ends 2026-09-23); its weight is a manual prior.
Each agent's h48 was checked against the lineage hash in research/ladder/fingerprints_raw.txt.
A lineage's weight is split evenly over its agents. Paths are relative to the repo root;
the agent files live in gitignored folders on this machine.

herd-safe.share_note: manual prior: 5 public herd-safe forks appeared 09-24/25, none in the dataset yet
